summary: The notebook has two published notes: a foundations course note on gradient descent and a reading note on the Transformer paper.

areas.label: Machine Learning
areas.coverage: Covers gradient descent fundamentals: the update rule, learning-rate intuition, and a worked quadratic example.
areas.gap: Only one course note exists; broader ML foundations topics like regularization, loss functions, and generalization are not yet covered.

areas.label: Deep Learning
areas.coverage: Covers the Transformer architecture: scaled dot-product attention, multi-head attention, positional encodings, and WMT results.
areas.gap: No notes on follow-up architectures, sub-quadratic attention, or training-stability and scaling recipes despite being flagged as improvements.
